senses.en: a slow-moving creature with a long segmented body and many legs

example.en: A millipede curled up under the log.
example.zh: 一只千足虫在木头下蜷成一团。

senses.en: coming after sixty-nine in order; 70th

example.en: Her seventieth birthday was a big celebration.
example.zh: 她的七十岁生日办了一场盛大的庆祝会。

senses.en: one of seventy equal parts; the 70th in a series

example.en: She inherited a seventieth of the estate.
example.zh: 她继承了遗产的七十分之一。

senses.en: rude or lacking politeness and courtesy

example.en: It seemed ungracious to refuse her kind invitation.
example.zh: 拒绝她善意的邀请似乎有些失礼。

senses.en: a member of the Māori people, Indigenous to New Zealand
senses.zh: 毛利人（新西兰原住民族的一员）

example.en: She is a Māori from Auckland.
example.zh: 她是来自奥克兰的一位毛利人。

senses.en: the Polynesian language of the Māori people

example.en: She is learning to speak Māori.
example.zh: 她正在学习说毛利语。

senses.en: relating to the Māori people, their language, or their culture
senses.zh: 毛利人的；毛利语的；毛利文化的

example.en: The exhibition celebrates Māori art.
example.zh: 这次展览致敬毛利艺术。

senses.en: a climbing evergreen plant with lobed leaves

example.en: Ivy covered the walls of the old building.
example.zh: 常春藤爬满了那座老楼的墙壁。

senses.en: a medical condition involving addiction to and dependence on alcohol

example.en: Alcoholism is now widely treated as a chronic illness.
example.zh: 酒精成瘾如今被广泛视为一种慢性疾病。

senses.en: to adopt or support an idea, cause, or belief

example.en: The party espoused a policy of free trade.
example.zh: 该党拥护自由贸易政策。

senses.en: (old use or formal) to marry

example.en: He espoused her in a quiet ceremony.
example.zh: 他在一场安静的仪式上娶了她。

senses.en: to state something firmly and confidently

example.en: She asserted that the report was accurate.
example.zh: 她坚称那份报告是准确的。

senses.en: to defend or enforce a right, authority, or position
senses.zh: 维护，主张（权利、权威或地位）

example.en: The group worked to assert its right to peaceful protest.
example.zh: 该团体努力维护其和平抗议的权利。

senses.en: the title printed above a newspaper article

example.en: The headline said that the school would close.
example.zh: 标题说这所学校将关闭。

senses.en: to be the main performer or attraction at an event

example.en: The singer will headline the concert.
example.zh: 这位歌手将领衔这场音乐会。

senses.en: relating to the culture of ancient Greece and Rome
senses.zh: 古希腊和古罗马文化的

example.en: She studied classical literature at university.
example.zh: 她在大学学习古典文学。

senses.en: following traditional forms and styles, especially in music

example.en: The radio station plays classical music all day.
example.zh: 这家电台整天播放古典音乐。

senses.en: a plant without a woody stem, especially one used to flavor food
senses.zh: 草本植物，尤指用于调味的香草

example.en: She grows herbs on the kitchen windowsill.
example.zh: 她在厨房窗台上种香草。

senses.en: a plant used for its medicinal properties

example.en: People in the village still gather herbs for traditional remedies.
example.zh: 村里的人仍然采集草药用于传统疗法。

senses.en: the art or practice of taking photographs with a camera

example.en: She is studying photography at college.
example.zh: 她在大学学习摄影。

senses.en: an idea, opinion, or detail that someone mentions

example.en: She made a good point about the cost.
example.zh: 她关于成本提出了一个好观点。

senses.en: a unit used for scoring in a game or competition

example.en: Our team scored three points in the final minute.
example.zh: 我们队在最后一分钟得了三分。

senses.en: to show a direction or place by holding out a finger or object

example.en: She pointed at the map on the wall.
example.zh: 她指向墙上的地图。

senses.en: the events of the past, or the study of them

example.en: She studied history at university.
example.zh: 她在大学学习历史。

senses.en: a record or account of past events

example.en: The museum preserves the history of the town.
example.zh: 博物馆保存着这座小镇的历史。

senses.en: a person's past experiences or medical background

example.en: The doctor asked about her medical history.
example.zh: 医生询问了她的病史。

senses.en: relating to a particular nearby area, town, or neighborhood

example.en: We shop at the local market every Saturday.
example.zh: 我们每周六在当地市场购物。

senses.en: a person who lives in a particular area

example.en: The café is popular with locals.
example.zh: 这家咖啡馆很受当地人欢迎。

senses.en: A legislative or governing body, especially an upper house in some countries or a university council.
senses.zh: 参议院；立法机构；评议会

example.en: The bill must pass the senate before it becomes law.
example.zh: 该法案必须先在参议院通过才能成为法律。

senses.en: The upper house of the United States Congress.

example.en: The Senate voted on the nomination.
example.zh: 参议院对这项提名进行了投票。

senses.en: to say or write something again

example.en: Could you repeat the question, please?
example.zh: 请你把问题再说一遍好吗？

senses.en: to do something again

example.en: The experiment was repeated to confirm the result.
example.zh: 为了确认结果，实验被再次进行。

senses.en: an event that happens again in the same way

example.en: We want to avoid a repeat of last year's problem.
example.zh: 我们希望避免去年问题再次发生。

senses.en: the act of talking to God or a deity, often to give thanks or ask for help
senses.zh: 与上帝或神明交谈的行为，通常用于感恩或求助

example.en: She said a quiet prayer before the meal.
example.zh: 她在饭前默默祈祷。

senses.en: words spoken or read when praying
senses.zh: 祈祷时所说或所读的话；祷词

example.en: The children learned a short prayer at school.
example.zh: 孩子们在学校学了一段简短的祷词。

senses.en: money provided for a project, organization, or activity

example.en: The research project received funding from a local charity.
example.zh: 这个研究项目获得了一家当地慈善机构的资助。

senses.en: happening or done at once, without delay

example.en: The medicine had an immediate effect.
example.zh: 这种药立刻产生了效果。

senses.en: needed now and requiring urgent attention

example.en: The refugees need immediate help.
example.zh: 难民需要立即援助。

senses.en: closest in space, time, or relationship; direct
senses.zh: 最接近的；直系的；直接的

example.en: She called her immediate family first.
example.zh: 她首先联系了直系亲属。

senses.en: the branch of physics that studies light and its behavior

example.en: She studied optics at university to learn how lenses work.
example.zh: 她在大学学习光学，以了解透镜的工作原理。

senses.en: the way something appears to the public, especially in politics or business
senses.zh: （尤指政治、商业上的）公众形象，观感

example.en: The company canceled the event because of the bad optics.
example.zh: 由于负面观感，该公司取消了这场活动。

senses.en: to look through things casually or superficially

example.en: She likes to browse through magazines at the bookstore.
example.zh: 她喜欢在书店里翻阅杂志。

senses.en: to look at goods in a shop without intending to buy

example.en: We spent the afternoon browsing in the mall.
example.zh: 我们下午在商场里闲逛。

senses.en: an act of looking through things casually

example.en: A quick browse of the menu showed many vegetarian options.
example.zh: 快速浏览了一下菜单，发现有很多素食选择。

senses.en: young shoots, twigs and leaves eaten by animals

example.en: The deer fed on the browse in the forest.
example.zh: 鹿在森林里以嫩枝叶为食。

senses.en: a deep breath taken through a wide open mouth, usually from tiredness or boredom

example.en: He tried to hide a yawn during the long meeting.
example.zh: 他在冗长的会议中努力掩饰一个哈欠。

senses.en: to open the mouth wide and take a deep breath, usually when tired or bored

example.en: She yawned and stretched after sitting still for hours.
example.zh: 久坐数小时后，她打着哈欠伸了个懒腰。

senses.en: to be wide open (of a hole or gap)

example.en: A deep canyon yawned before the hikers.
example.zh: 一道深邃的峡谷豁然呈现在徒步者面前。

senses.en: skilled and good at doing something

example.en: She is proficient in three languages.
example.zh: 她精通三种语言。

senses.en: to separate one group of people from others, especially by race or religion

example.en: The old laws segregated Black students from white students in schools.
example.zh: 旧法律曾在学校中将黑人学生与白人学生隔离开来。

senses.en: to separate one thing or set of things from the rest

example.en: Residents are asked to segregate their recyclable waste before collection.
example.zh: 居民被要求在垃圾收集前把可回收物分开。

senses.en: the gradual damaging or eating away of a metal by chemical action, such as rusting

example.en: Regular painting helps protect the bridge from corrosion.
example.zh: 定期刷漆有助于保护大桥免受腐蚀。

senses.en: gradual damage or weakening caused by chemicals

example.en: The pipes showed signs of corrosion after years of chemical exposure.
example.zh: 经过多年化学品侵蚀，管道出现了损坏迹象。

senses.en: the spring season of the year

example.en: The countryside looks beautiful in springtime.
example.zh: 春天的乡村看起来很美。

senses.en: relating to the way a person or animal acts

example.en: The study examined behavioral changes in the students.
example.zh: 这项研究考察了学生行为上的变化。

senses.en: cheap enough for most people to pay for
senses.zh: 价格合理的；负担得起的

example.en: The city needs more affordable housing.
example.zh: 这座城市需要更多价格实惠的住房。

senses.en: a frying pan, especially a heavy iron one

example.en: She fried the eggs in a cast-iron skillet.
example.zh: 她用铸铁煎锅煎鸡蛋。

senses.en: a person in charge of a museum, gallery or collection
senses.zh: （博物馆、美术馆等的）馆长；策展人

example.en: The curator organized an exhibition of modern paintings.
example.zh: 馆长策划了一场现代绘画展览。

senses.en: used to make a word, phrase or sentence negative

example.en: I am not tired.
example.zh: 我不累。

senses.en: an opinion or conclusion about something

example.en: In my judgment, the plan is too risky.
example.zh: 依我看，这个计划风险太大。

senses.en: good sense; the ability to make sensible decisions

example.en: She showed good judgment by staying calm.
example.zh: 她保持冷静，表现出良好的判断力。

senses.en: (law) an official court decision

example.en: The court delivered its judgment on Friday.
example.zh: 法院于周五作出判决。

senses.en: a male given name

example.en: Lloyd is my uncle's first name.
example.zh: 劳埃德是我叔叔的名字。

senses.en: to refuse to accept responsibility for or deny any connection with something
senses.zh: 否认；拒绝承担责任；撇清关系

example.en: The government disavowed any involvement in the attack.
example.zh: 政府否认与这次袭击有任何牵连。

senses.en: the resistance of a solid material to scratching or indentation

example.en: Diamond is famous for its extreme hardness.
example.zh: 钻石以其极高的硬度而闻名。

senses.en: a property of water caused mainly by dissolved calcium and magnesium

example.en: Hardness in water makes soap lather poorly.
example.zh: 水的硬度高会使肥皂不易起泡。

senses.en: feeling or looking like rubber; elastic and springy

example.en: The mat had a rubbery surface.
example.zh: 垫子表面像橡胶一样。

senses.en: (of food) tough and hard to chew

example.en: The squid turned out rubbery and bland.
example.zh: 鱿鱼嚼不动而且没味道。

senses.en: a plate that controls airflow in a chimney, stove, or furnace
senses.zh: （烟囱、炉子的）风门；气流调节板

example.en: Open the damper to let the fire burn better.
example.zh: 打开风门，让火烧得更旺些。

senses.en: a device that reduces vibration or oscillation

example.en: The machine uses a damper to reduce vibrations.
example.zh: 这台机器用减震器来减少振动。

senses.en: intended to explain something

example.en: The manual includes explanatory notes for each step.
example.zh: 手册中每个步骤都附有说明性注释。

senses.en: a person or thing with the same name as another

example.en: She met her namesake at the conference by chance.
example.zh: 她在会议上偶遇了与自己同名的人。

senses.en: surrounded by difficulties, controversy, or conflict
senses.zh: 处境艰难的；四面受敌的

example.en: The embattled CEO faced calls to resign.
example.zh: 这位处境艰难的首席执行官面临辞职的呼声。

senses.en: prepared or fortified for battle

example.en: The embattled garrison refused to surrender.
example.zh: 严阵以待的守军拒绝投降。

senses.en: a flooded field where rice is grown

example.en: Farmers were working in the paddy fields.
example.zh: 农民们正在稻田里干活。

senses.en: unhusked rice grain

example.en: The farmers sold their paddy at the market.
example.zh: 农民们在市场上出售稻谷。

senses.en: (offensive slang, British) an offensive term for an Irish person
senses.zh: （冒犯语，英式）对爱尔兰人的蔑称

example.en: The article notes that Paddy can be used as an offensive label for an Irish person.
example.zh: 这篇文章指出，Paddy 有时被用作对爱尔兰人的冒犯性称呼。

senses.en: a familiar form of the male name Patrick (written Paddy)
senses.zh: 帕迪（男子名 Patrick 的昵称）

example.en: His friends call him Paddy.
example.zh: 他的朋友们叫他帕迪。

senses.en: a small bag with a strap, used for carrying books or other items

example.en: She carried her books in a leather satchel.
example.zh: 她用皮质挎包装着书。

senses.en: to change something slightly to make it better or more suitable

example.en: Please adjust the seat before driving.
example.zh: 开车前请调整座椅。

senses.en: to get used to a new situation or condition

example.en: It took her a while to adjust to the new schedule.
example.zh: 她花了一段时间才适应新的日程安排。

senses.en: to set or regulate a device or control

example.en: The technician adjusted the thermostat to save energy.
example.zh: 技术员调节了恒温器以节省能源。

senses.en: a movable panel that opens and closes an entrance

example.en: Please close the door quietly.
example.zh: 请轻轻地关门。

senses.en: an entrance or doorway to a room, building, or vehicle

example.en: She stood at the door waiting for a taxi.
example.zh: 她站在门口等出租车。

senses.en: a way to reach an opportunity or new possibility

example.en: A good education opens doors.
example.zh: 良好的教育能打开机会之门。

senses.en: a small vehicle that travels on water

example.en: We rowed a boat across the lake.
example.zh: 我们划船穿过湖。

senses.en: to travel or carry something by boat

example.en: They boated to the island at sunrise.
example.zh: 日出时他们乘船去了岛上。

senses.en: the result or effect of an event or process

example.en: The outcome of the meeting was a new plan.
example.zh: 会议的结果是一项新计划。

senses.en: to bend something so that one part lies over another

example.en: She folded the letter and put it in her bag.
example.zh: 她把信折好，放进了包里。

senses.en: a line or crease made by folding

example.en: There was a deep fold in the old map.
example.zh: 那张旧地图上有一道很深的折痕。

senses.en: an enclosed area where sheep are kept

example.en: The farmer led the sheep into the fold.
example.zh: 农夫把羊领进了羊圈。

senses.en: to raise something to a higher position

example.en: Elevate the injured leg to reduce swelling.
example.zh: 把受伤的腿抬高以减轻肿胀。

senses.en: to promote someone to a higher rank or position

example.en: She was elevated to senior manager last year.
example.zh: 她去年被晋升为高级经理。

collocations: elevate someone to a higher position

senses.en: to make something better or more refined

example.en: The speech elevated the mood of the whole audience.
example.zh: 这场演讲鼓舞了全场听众的情绪。

senses.en: physically strong and solid; well built

example.en: She bought a sturdy table that will last for years.
example.zh: 她买了一张结实耐用的桌子。

senses.en: firm and determined; not easily weakened

example.en: The protesters put up sturdy resistance to the new policy.
example.zh: 抗议者对新政策进行了顽强的抵制。

senses.en: a combination of three or more musical notes played together

example.en: She played a G major chord on the guitar.
example.zh: 她在吉他上弹了一个G大调和弦。

senses.en: a straight line joining two points on a curve or circle

example.en: Draw a chord across the circle.
example.zh: 在圆上画一条弦。

senses.en: to play chords on a stringed instrument

example.en: He chorded the song on his guitar.
example.zh: 他用吉他为这首歌配了和弦。

senses.en: to wash oneself or part of the body in water

example.en: She likes to bathe before going to bed.
example.zh: 她喜欢睡前洗个澡。

senses.en: to swim or relax in water for pleasure

example.en: Tourists bathe in the sea every summer.
example.zh: 每年夏天游客都在海里游泳。

senses.en: to cover or surround something with light or a feeling

example.en: The room was bathed in warm sunlight.
example.zh: 房间沐浴在温暖的阳光里。

senses.en: having or showing creativity and a good imagination
senses.zh: 富有想象力的；有创意的

example.en: She came up with an imaginative solution to the problem.
example.zh: 她为这个问题想出了一个富有创意的解决办法。

senses.en: relating to or resulting from imagination rather than reality

example.en: The novel is a work of imaginative fiction.
example.zh: 这部小说是一部想象出来的虚构作品。

senses.en: a change, especially an up-and-down or irregular one, in level, amount or value

example.en: The stock market saw sharp fluctuations this week.
example.zh: 本周股市出现了剧烈波动。

senses.en: a shape like a circle or ring formed by a curve that closes

example.en: The road makes a loop around the lake.
example.zh: 这条路绕湖形成了一个环。

senses.en: (in computing) a part of a program in which instructions are repeated

example.en: The program runs in a loop until the user quits.
example.zh: 程序循环运行，直到用户退出。

senses.en: to form or move in a loop

example.en: The river loops through the valley.
example.zh: 河流蜿蜒环绕穿过山谷。

senses.en: a product or raw material that is bought and sold

example.en: Oil is one of the most heavily traded commodities in the world.
example.zh: 石油是世界上交易量最大的商品之一。

senses.en: something useful or valuable
senses.zh: 有用的东西；有价值的事物

example.en: In a busy city, free time is a precious commodity.
example.zh: 在繁忙的城市里，空闲时间是宝贵的资源。

senses.en: the process by which living things get and use food for growth and health

example.en: Good nutrition is important for children's growth.
example.zh: 良好的营养对儿童的生长很重要。

senses.en: the scientific study of food and how the body uses it

example.en: She is studying nutrition at university.
example.zh: 她在大学学习营养学。

senses.en: a Muslim place of worship

example.en: They attend Friday prayers at the mosque near the city center.
example.zh: 他们在市中心附近的清真寺参加星期五的礼拜。

senses.en: not level, smooth, or regular

example.en: The path was uneven and covered with stones.
example.zh: 这条小路不平，布满石头。

senses.en: varying in quality or performance

example.en: The team's performance has been uneven this season.
example.zh: 这个队本赛季的表现起伏不定。

senses.en: small in amount or poor in quality; lacking

example.en: She survived on a meager salary for years.
example.zh: 多年来她靠微薄的薪水度日。

senses.en: a small mammal such as a mouse, rat, or squirrel that gnaws with continuously growing front teeth

example.en: Rats and squirrels are common rodents.
example.zh: 老鼠和松鼠是常见的啮齿动物。

senses.en: a person who studies plants and animals in nature

example.en: The naturalist spent years observing birds in the rainforest.
example.zh: 这位博物学家花了多年观察雨林中的鸟类。

senses.en: a follower of naturalism in art, literature or philosophy

example.en: As a literary naturalist, he portrayed life with scientific detachment.
example.zh: 作为文学上的自然主义者，他以科学的超然态度描绘生活。

senses.en: a short written message or note, especially in business

example.en: She sent a memorandum to all staff about the meeting.
example.zh: 她向全体员工发了一份关于会议的备忘录。

senses.en: fuss, trouble, or busy activity

example.en: The meeting ended without further ado.
example.zh: 会议没有更多麻烦就结束了。

senses.en: complete certainty or confidence

example.en: She spoke with absolute certitude about the results.
example.zh: 她以十足的把握谈论结果。

senses.en: a small, very poor-quality house or shelter

example.en: They lived in a damp hovel on the edge of town.
example.zh: 他们住在镇边一间阴暗潮湿的破屋里。

senses.en: a person from the western part of a country or region; often a native or inhabitant of Western countries
senses.zh: 西方人；（某国）西部地区的人

example.en: Many Westerners travel to Asia for the holidays.
example.zh: 许多西方人到亚洲度假。

senses.en: to place or come between things or people

example.en: He interposed himself between the two arguing men.
example.zh: 他插到两个争吵的男人中间。

senses.en: to interrupt by saying something

example.en: 'Not now,' she interposed quietly.
example.zh: “现在不行，”她轻声插话道。

senses.en: an artist or designer who practices minimalism, using very simple forms

example.en: The minimalist exhibited a series of plain white canvases.
example.zh: 这位极简主义艺术家展出了一系列纯白画布作品。

senses.en: characterized by extreme simplicity of style or design

example.en: Their apartment has a minimalist interior with clean lines and no clutter.
example.zh: 他们的公寓采用极简主义室内设计，线条简洁，毫无杂乱。

senses.en: unwilling to do something

example.en: She was loath to admit her mistake.
example.zh: 她不愿承认自己的错误。

senses.en: places where people can sit; chairs or positions in a vehicle, theater or hall

example.en: All the seats in the theater were taken.
example.zh: 剧院里的座位全都被占了。

senses.en: to seat: to have places for people to sit, or to make someone sit

example.en: The stadium seats eighty thousand people.
example.zh: 这个体育场可容纳八万人就座。
